note: Curated pointers to the live runs behind each release-qualified cell. Campaign evidence itself never enters Git; a record with status 'claimed' carries the charter's claim without a machine-recorded run and is displayed as such.

records.source: AGENTS.md product boundary; multi-program qualification (xTB opt feeding ORCA/PySCF single points)

One live goal under the approval chain: from a hand-built bridging-hydrogen guess the session planned an ORCA OptTS with a frequency step at B3LYP/def2-SVP, selected the wave and executed it provider-free in 37.6 s of engine wall. The search converged to a first-order saddle of the HCN -> HNC 1,2-hydrogen shift, one imaginary mode at 1121.71 cm^-1, C-N 1.188 / C-H 1.197 / N-H 1.398 A -- the same saddle as the independent direct-CLI run (Slurm 2142375) to the last printed digit of its total energy, -93.224285928359 Eh. The session's own declared expectation band for the imaginary mode (1500-2500 cm^-1) was displayed as diverged and not scored.

The same goal's second cycle: an admitted revision cited cycle 1's evidence and walked one forward branch from that converged saddle, 669.3 s of engine wall under the same approval chain. The branch descended 33.62 kcal/mol over 21 path points and stopped at ORCA's iteration limit (irc_converged = 0), which the session carried into its uncertainty account; from the endpoint connectivity it read N-H formed and C-H broken, the HNC side, agreeing with the independent direct-CLI branches (Slurm 2142379) and with the optimised endpoint minima (Slurm 2142403). The goal settled unreachable_from_evidence because this release's claim machinery renders numerical claims only and the walk direction is a text label.

sealed CUHK goals (Slurm 2140676, 2140679, 2140681): closed-shell singlet B3LYP/def2-SVP branches on the CPU engine, from a supplied saddle (g1, g4) and from the saddle ORCA located in the same goal (g2); HF/6-31G* branches rest on the direct human-CLI runs (2140566, 2140568)

records.source: All four sealed goals of the campaign planned a PySCF ts node from ordinary language and executed one: six searches across four molecules, every one validated. g1 ran the chain end to end -- ts (reaching the same HCN/HNC saddle as the direct CLI and as ORCA, C-N 1.1882 / C-H 1.1966 / N-H 1.3977 A) feeding two irc branches that reached HCN and HNC, barriers 47.84 and 34.16 kcal/mol against the direct-CLI references to 0.01. g2 relaxed a supplied Hartree-Fock saddle onto the B3LYP/def2-SVP surface it was asked about (seed max|g| 0.0378 Eh/Bohr there, reached 3.5e-5) and delivered 87.25 kcal/mol -- the route the previous round's methoxy goal did not have. g3 diagnosed two of its own searches converging to non-saddles and built a seed that worked. g4 located the H2O2 cis rotation barrier structure (one imaginary mode, -612.8 cm-1) and delivered 34.72 kJ/mol. No goal settled achieved: g1 and g3 exhausted their revisions, g2 and g4 lost their last two cycles to a provider-transport outage. What the capability did is recorded here; what the goals delivered is not claimed beyond the two barriers above.

One extract_result_quantities call on a completed forward branch resolved the whole family in one receipt: direction forward, irc_converged 0, 21 path points, both ends' positions and connectivity, the connectivity change, and the path energies. The receipt names the endpoint sidecar hcn_hnc_ircf_IRC_F.xyz and its digest as native evidence; an expression over the path energies gave the branch's 33.4048 kcal/mol descent with no model-authored constant, and bind_reached_geometry then carried the endpoint structure into a new starting geometry.
